'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***Two people are killed and seven others are wounded in an attack on a [[International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement|Red Cross]] [[humanitarian aid]] convoy in [[Khartoum]], [[Sudan]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-67677528 (BBC News)]
**[[Abdel Fattah al-Burhan]] and [[Hemedti]] agree to meet in person before the end of the year to end the war between the [[Rapid Support Forces]] and the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] in [[Sudan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/sudan-war-military-rsf-burhan-dagalo-igad-4bc7a44bfb808d3b85be9d6921e4f856 (AP)]
*[[Yemeni civil war (2014–present)|Yemeni civil war]]
**[[French Navy]] [[French frigate Languedoc|frigate ''Languedoc'']] shoots down two [[unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]] over the [[Red Sea]] that were launched from [[Yemen]], according to the [[Ministry of Armed Forces (France)|French Armed Forces Ministry]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/french-warship-shoots-down-two-drones-coming-yemen-2023-12-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A fire at a work camp in [[Pará]], [[Brazil]], kills nine workers. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/International/wireStory/fire-breaks-encampment-landless-workers-brazils-amazon-killing-105534864 (ABC News)]
*A nationwide [[power outage]] occurs in [[Kenya]] as a result of possibe [[sabotage]] of the country's [[electrical grid]], according to Transport Minister [[Kipchumba Murkomen]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-67622517 (BBC News)]
